title: Panic in the Panth and the Gathering at Akal Bunga

blocks.text: The crisis worsens after Abdali is summoned with promises of money and support for the enemies of the Sikhs. As the rumors spread, families of the Sikhs started deserting in panic, and suffering follows every path: some flee toward the hills, some hide in forests, and others remain exposed to plunder and loss.

Against that fear, the Khalsa gathers itself in prayer and counsel. Rehras verses were recited in Khalsa congregation held at Akal Bunga near the Akal Takht, and the Singhs first see their families to safety before turning to the question of how the Panth should answer this danger.

Out of that assembly Gurbakhsh Singh raises the demand for true sacrifice. He asks whether there is any one such Singh among the Khalsa Panth who can offer his life in a way that will bring divine favor upon the community and steady the hearts of those who remain.
